description: This file defines a handler class for deleting charge definitions in the Fineract system. It implements the processing logic for the DELETE command specific to 'CHARGE' entities, utilizing the ChargeWritePlatformService for deletion.

classes.name: DeleteChargeDefinitionCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing command handling for deleting charge definitions, annotated for command type 'CHARGE' with action 'DELETE'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the deleteCharge method on the ChargeWritePlatformService with the entity ID extracted from the command.
